description: This file appears to be a shell script used for platform-specific firmware upgrade procedures, particularly for the bcm6368 platform within the Linux target directories. It defines functions for checking and performing upgrades, with minimal logic and a fallback default upgrade method.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the firmware image. Currently always returns success (0).

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade procedure based on the board name. For unrecognized boards, it defaults to 'default_do_upgrade'.
